description: This file defines an abstract base class HandlerBase for Drupal Views plugin handlers, including properties, constructor, and methods for managing view query components, options, relationships, and form interactions.

classes.name: HandlerBase
classes.description: An abstract base class for Drupal Views handler plugins, providing core properties and methods for managing view query components, options, relationships, and form interactions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the handler with configuration, plugin ID, and definition, setting is_handler to TRUE.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the handler with view, display, and options, setting properties based on options and definition.

methods.name: defineOptions
methods.description: Defines default options for the handler, including id, table, field, relationship, group_type, and admin_label.

methods.name: adminLabel
methods.description: Returns the administrative label for the handler, optionally short.

methods.name: getField
methods.description: Returns the field name, considering grouping and aggregation.

methods.name: sanitizeValue
methods.description: Sanitizes a value based on specified type (xss, url, admin).

methods.name: caseTransform
methods.description: Transforms a string to upper, lower, ucfirst, or ucwords.

methods.name: buildOptionsForm
methods.description: Builds the options form for the handler, including admin label and additional settings.

methods.name: getModuleHandler
methods.description: Retrieves the module handler service, caching it.

methods.name: setModuleHandler
methods.description: Sets the module handler service.

methods.name: usesGroupBy
methods.description: Indicates whether the handler supports group by.

methods.name: buildGroupByForm
methods.description: Builds the form for group by options.

methods.name: submitGroupByForm
methods.description: Handles submission of group by form, updating options.

methods.name: hasExtraOptions
methods.description: Indicates whether the handler has extra options.

methods.name: defineExtraOptions
methods.description: Deprecated method for defining extra options.

methods.name: buildExtraOptionsForm
methods.description: Builds extra options form.

methods.name: validateExtraOptionsForm
methods.description: Validates extra options form.

methods.name: submitExtraOptionsForm
methods.description: Handles submission of extra options form.

methods.name: canExpose
methods.description: Indicates if the handler can be exposed.

methods.name: defaultExposeOptions
methods.description: Sets default options when exposing.

methods.name: exposedInfo
methods.description: Provides info about exposed form.

methods.name: buildExposedForm
methods.description: Builds the exposed form.

methods.name: validateExposed
methods.description: Validates exposed form.

methods.name: submitExposed
methods.description: Handles submission of exposed form.

methods.name: buildExposeForm
methods.description: Builds the expose form.

methods.name: validateExposeForm
methods.description: Validates expose form.

methods.name: submitExposeForm
methods.description: Handles submission of expose form.

methods.name: showExposeButton
methods.description: Displays expose/hide button.

methods.name: showExposeForm
methods.description: Displays the expose form when exposed.

methods.name: access
methods.description: Checks access permissions for a user.

methods.name: preQuery
methods.description: Prepares the query before execution.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Executes the query.

methods.name: postExecute
methods.description: Post-processing after query execution.

methods.name: placeholder
methods.description: Provides a unique placeholder string for the handler.

methods.name: setRelationship
methods.description: Sets the relationship for the handler based on options.

methods.name: ensureMyTable
methods.description: Ensures the handler's table is available and returns its alias.

methods.name: adminSummary
methods.description: Provides an admin summary of the handler.

methods.name: isExposed
methods.description: Checks if the handler is exposed.

methods.name: isAGroup
methods.description: Indicates if the filter is a group.

methods.name: multipleExposedInput
methods.description: Indicates if multiple exposed inputs are allowed.

methods.name: acceptExposedInput
methods.description: Accepts input from exposed filters.

methods.name: storeExposedInput
methods.description: Stores exposed input in session.

methods.name: getJoin
methods.description: Gets the join object for the handler.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the handler.

methods.name: broken
methods.description: Checks if the handler is broken.

methods.name: getDateFormat
methods.description: Creates cross-database SQL date format string.

methods.name: getDateField
methods.description: Returns the date field SQL string.

methods.name: getViewsData
methods.description: Retrieves the Views data service.

methods.name: setViewsData
methods.description: Sets the Views data service.

methods.name: getTableJoin
methods.description: Creates a join object for the specified table and base table.

methods.name: getEntityType
methods.description: Returns the entity type associated with the handler.

methods.name: breakString
methods.description: Splits a string into values based on operators, returning an object with values and operator.

methods.name: displayExposedForm
methods.description: Displays the exposed form for the handler.

methods.name: submitTemporaryForm
methods.description: Handles temporary form submission, updating handler options and view cache.

methods.name: submitFormCalculateOptions
methods.description: Calculates and merges options from form submission.

methods.name: calculateDependencies
methods.description: Calculates dependencies for the handler, including module dependencies.
